summary: A role-based recessed/downlight design and estimating workspace where electricians create persistent projects, rooms, layouts, product selections and estimates while admins manage users, roles and default settings.

journeys.title: An electrician signs in, creates a project, designs a room layout, selects a product and views an estimate

steps.expect: email and password fields are visible, and demo Admin and Electrician credentials are displayed

steps.action: sign in as the seeded electrician demo account
steps.expect: the Dashboard is shown with navigation for Dashboard, Projects, Products Catalogue and Estimate, and no Admin navigation is visible
the projects list is visible with Create Project, search and status filter controls

steps.action: create a new active lighting project
steps.expect: the new project named Acme Kitchen Lighting appears in the projects list with Active status

steps.action: open the project detail route for the new project
steps.expect: the project detail page shows Acme Kitchen Lighting, a Rooms section and an Estimate Summary link

steps.action: add a room using realistic design inputs
steps.expect: the Kitchen room appears with labels for area, lumen requirement, required fittings, suggested rows and columns, edge spacing and an estimates-not-compliance disclaimer
the room shows area 20.00 m², approximate lumen requirement 6000 lm and estimated required downlights 9

steps.action: change the number of fittings and recalculate the layout
steps.expect: the top-down room diagram shows 10 proposed downlight markers arranged within the room boundary

steps.action: add a manual fitting by clicking the diagram
steps.expect: one additional downlight marker appears on the diagram and the saved layout count increases

steps.action: remove a fitting from the diagram
steps.expect: the selected downlight marker is removed and the saved layout count decreases
a seeded downlight catalogue is visible with manufacturer, model, wattage, lumens, beam angle, colour temperature, fire rating, IP rating and unit cost

steps.action: select a downlight product for the room
steps.expect: the room shows the selected downlight and updated wattage, lumens, beam angle and material cost
the estimate page shows total fitting quantity, material cost, labour rate, labour hours, labour cost, subtotal, total and a room-by-room breakdown

steps.action: set labour rate and estimated installation time
steps.expect: labour cost is shown as 390.00 and the project total updates
the signed-in project detail and estimate still show Acme Kitchen Lighting, the Kitchen room, saved layout positions, selected product and calculated totals

acceptance: an electrician can create a project and room that remain visible after a full page reload
room calculations show area, lumen requirement, fitting quantity, spacing and estimate disclaimers
layout marker changes persist to the room and survive reload
product selection updates room wattage, lumens, beam angle and material cost

journeys.title: An electrician searches, filters, renames and deletes projects

steps.expect: the projects list, search input, status filter and clear filters control are visible

steps.action: search for the created project by customer/project name
steps.expect: the projects list shows Acme Kitchen Lighting
only projects with Active status are shown and Acme Kitchen Lighting remains visible
the search input is cleared, the status filter returns to All statuses and the unfiltered projects list is visible
the project title updates to Acme Kitchen and Hall Lighting
the project is removed from the projects list and a deletion confirmation message is visible

acceptance: project search returns a matching project by name
status filtering visibly limits the projects list
clear filters restores the full list
renamed project names persist until deletion

journeys.title: An admin manages users, roles and system defaults

steps.expect: demo Admin and Electrician credentials are visible

steps.action: sign in as the seeded admin demo account
steps.expect: the Dashboard is shown and Admin navigation is visible
the admin area shows user management, role controls and system settings
the selected user row shows role Electrician and a saved confirmation is visible
Kitchen default lux target is shown as 325 lux and a saved confirmation is visible
default labour rate is shown as 72.00 and a saved confirmation is visible
the admin settings still show Kitchen default lux target 325 and default labour rate 72.00

acceptance: admins can see and open Admin navigation
role changes are persisted and visible after save
default lux targets persist after reload
default labour rate persists after reload

journeys.title: An electrician is blocked from admin controls and routes

steps.expect: the sign-in form and demo credentials are visible

steps.action: sign in as the seeded electrician demo account
steps.expect: the Dashboard is shown with no Admin navigation item
an Access denied message is shown and user management controls are not visible

acceptance: electricians who open /admin manually see Access denied
admin user and settings controls are not visible to electricians

journeys.title: An electrician downloads an estimate summary for a project

steps.expect: the estimate page shows room-by-room quantities, selected downlights, wattage, material cost, labour cost, subtotal and total
a downloadable CSV or text estimate summary is produced containing the project name, room name, fitting quantity, selected downlight, material cost, labour cost and total

acceptance: the export control produces a downloadable estimate file
the downloaded estimate includes current project and room totals
the exported content labels values as design estimates

routes.name: Sign In
routes.purpose: Email/password sign-in with visible seeded demo Admin and Electrician credentials

routes.name: Dashboard
routes.purpose: Authenticated dashboard showing project count, total rooms designed, total fittings specified and estimated value of active projects with design-estimate disclaimers

routes.name: Projects
routes.purpose: Create, search, filter, rename, delete and open lighting projects owned by the signed-in electrician

routes.name: Project Detail
routes.purpose: Manage rooms, room calculations, top-down layout editor and room product selections for one project

routes.name: Estimate Summary
routes.purpose: Show project-wide estimate totals, room-by-room breakdown and export/download controls

routes.name: Products Catalogue
routes.purpose: Search and filter seeded downlight products and view product specifications and unit cost

routes.name: Admin Area
routes.purpose: Admin-only user role management and default system settings management

entities.name: appUser
relationships: an appUser is linked to one backend auth user
an appUser role controls access to admin routes and controls

entities.name: project
relationships: a project belongs to one signed-in electrician

entities.name: room
relationships: a room belongs to one project
a room may reference one selected product
layout state belongs to the room

entities.name: product
relationships: products can be selected by rooms

entities.name: systemSettings
relationships: settings provide default lux targets by room type and default labour rate

auth.model: email + password via the backend SDK
rules: signed-out visitors are redirected to /signin when opening authenticated routes
the sign-in screen visibly displays seeded demo Admin and Electrician credentials for preview use
projects and rooms are visible only to their owner electrician
admins can administer users and system settings
only users with role Admin can see Admin navigation
electricians manually opening /admin see Access denied and cannot see user or settings controls

operations.description: authenticate with auth.signIn and load the signed-in user's role profile
persist a new project owned by the signed-in electrician
delete an owned project from the projects list
reset transient project search and status filter controls

responsibilities.behavior: clear the visible project search text and restore status filter to All statuses without mutating stored projects

operations.description: persist a room in a project using room inputs and default settings

responsibilities.behavior: calculate initial room area, lumen requirement, required fittings, suggested rows and columns, spacing, beam cone diameter, warnings, estimated wattage and initial layout positions

operations.description: recalculate lighting estimates for a room

responsibilities.behavior: calculate area as length x width, lumen requirement as area x target lux, required fittings as ceiling(lumen requirement / lumens per fitting), proportional row/column layout, spacing after edge offsets, edge spacing, beam cone diameter at working plane and warnings for unsuitable beam coverage or excessive spacing relative to ceiling height

operations.description: recalculate room downlight positions when fitting count changes

responsibilities.behavior: derive a row and column layout from room proportions and fitting count, then generate evenly spaced top-down fitting positions inside the room after edge offsets

operations.description: persist manual layout marker additions or removals to the room

responsibilities.behavior: update fitting count to match the current saved layout position array

operations.description: select a catalogue product for a room and update room lighting/material values

responsibilities.behavior: copy selected product wattage, lumens and beam angle into room design inputs and calculate material cost as fitting count x product unit cost

operations.description: calculate project estimate totals from rooms, selected products and labour inputs

responsibilities.behavior: sum room fitting counts, room material costs and room counts, calculate labour cost as labour rate x labour hours, calculate subtotal and total

operations.description: download a CSV or text estimate summary from the current project state

responsibilities.behavior: produce a downloadable estimate summary file containing project name, estimate disclaimer, every room, fitting quantity, selected downlight, estimated wattage, material cost, labour cost, subtotal and total

operations.description: admin updates a user's role for preview role management
admin updates a default lux target for a room type
admin updates default labour rate and calculation settings

integrations.name: backend SDK auth
integrations.purpose: email/password sign-in, sign-out and current user lookup

integrations.name: backend SDK database
integrations.purpose: durable persistence for users, roles, projects, rooms, layout positions, products, settings and estimates

states.success: project count, total rooms designed, total fittings specified and estimated value of active projects are visible

states.success: seeded products display specifications and unit costs

acceptance.statement: the sign-in screen displays seeded demo Admin and Electrician credentials and accepts email/password sign-in
an electrician-created project appears at /projects/:projectId and remains after a full page reload
a room with length 5, width 4, target lux 300 and 720 lumens per fitting displays area 20.00 m², lumen requirement 6000 lm and required downlights 9
changing fitting count and editing layout markers updates the visible diagram and the saved layout survives reload
selecting a catalogue product for a room updates and persists lumens, wattage, beam angle and material cost
with labour rate 65 and labour hours 6, the estimate displays labour cost 390.00 and updates the total
project search by Acme Kitchen and Active status filtering show the matching active project and clear filters restores the full list
admins can open /admin and persist role, default lux target and default labour rate changes
electricians cannot see Admin navigation and opening /admin manually shows Access denied without admin controls
the estimate download control produces a downloadable CSV or text file containing the current project name, room breakdown, totals and design-estimate disclaimer

deferred.reason: the requested calculations must be clearly labelled as design estimates, not regulatory compliance calculations

deferred.item: supplier ordering and live product pricing integrations
deferred.reason: the request asks for a seeded small product catalogue and estimates, not external procurement
the request does not include payments
the request defines projects as belonging to signed-in users and admins administering users/settings
